About Blue Fox in Heathrow

Local landscaping and exterior cleaning.

Blue Fox Landscape & Services offers the community of Heathrow, FL, and the surrounding areas local landscape design & construction, power washing & soft washing services. Our landscape design & construction team will meet with you to transform your landscaping vision into a reality. Our pressure washing and soft washing specialists will ensure mold, dirt, stains and grime are removed from your driveways, parking lots, siding, roof, gutters, patios, fencing, gates and more.

Working in Heathrow

What tends to matter here.

Established landscapes

Heathrow is heavily planted and largely deed-restricted, so design work is often about matching a standard that already exists.

Hedges and lawns

Clipped hedge lines and large lawns are the backbone of most properties here.

Residential and commercial

Homes, communities and commercial sites alike.

Questions

Before you call.

Do you serve Heathrow?

Yes. Heathrow is one of the five communities in our established service area, for residential and commercial properties.

Is the estimate free?

Yes. Estimates are free. The only published fee is digital landscape design work: as of 7/1/2023 it is $250, with a 50% deposit, and the $250 is credited toward the landscape project if the package is approved.

Can you do landscaping and washing on the same property?

Yes. Both halves are handled by one company, so they can be scoped and scheduled together.
